headline_question: What does evidence governance buy, and cost, in recursive solver improvement? Answered as a Pareto tradeoff (throughput / development gain vs false promotion / evaluator integrity / honest-terminal rate), never a scalar verdict.

registered_comparator_shape.registered_role: the ungoverned control arm; transfer question inverted: does governance cost throughput relative to this loop where its preconditions hold?

frozen_proposal_stream.note: both arms receive the IDENTICAL ordered stream of allocator mutation proposals; the stream mirrors receipted historical variants plus parametric mutations plus one planted dud

proposals.desc: v1 policy: floor slot + retention repair + principle-until-0.90 + argmin level block
v1 with cumulative PRINCIPLE spend capped at 8 (X1 lever)
v1 with the 7 target slots spread (2,2,1,1,1) over ascending-mastery non-principle coordinates (X2 lever)
marginal-gain water-filling, EMA alpha 0.5 (the Path-A challenger)
marginal-gain without the principle floor slot
marginal-gain + 1 retention slot when retention mastery < 0.6
planted dud: uniform random coordinate draws

eval_unit: one policy evaluated over 6 worlds x 32 replicates on one instrument+seed

UNGOVERNED_GREEDY.environment: reference instrument, dev seed; the arm has no admissibility mechanic and therefore does not know the instrument cannot resolve its estimand
UNGOVERNED_GREEDY.acceptance_rule: evaluate each proposal in stream order on the held-out development scalar (balanced-mastery mean); accept iff scalar strictly exceeds the current incumbent's scalar; incumbent starts at D_STATIC_STRUCTURAL; no gates, no safety constraint, no ceiling admissibility, no CANNOT_CHECK

GOVERNED.pipeline: 1) oracle-ceiling admissibility on the reference instrument (verdict already receipted INADMISSIBLE; cost charged as 2 eval-units by declaration) -> every reference-instrument comparison refused as CANNOT_CHECK; 2) licensed v2 instrument (ADMISSIBLE, licensing cost 2 eval-units by declaration); 3) evaluate all 14 proposals on the licensed dev seed; screening gate (frozen): F-D balanced >= 0.05 AND safety harm vs D >= -0.01; 4) one assurance eval-unit of the single best screening survivor; promote iff the frozen v2 gate family is green (>=0.05 with CI low > 0, safety >= -0.01, all worlds positive)
GOVERNED.budget: 14 dev eval-units + 1 assurance eval-unit + 4 declared qualification units = 19

truth_meter: experimenter-level, outside both arms: every accepted candidate of either arm is evaluated once on the licensed v2 instrument at the truth seed; charged to the experiment, not to either arm's budget
frozen_outcome_vector_per_arm: development gain (the arm's own scalar for its final incumbent minus static, on the arm's own instrument)
fresh-assurance gain (licensed-instrument truth-seed F-D contrast of the final incumbent)
false-promotion count: accepted candidates whose licensed-instrument truth advantage over the arm's previous incumbent has mean <= 0
honest-terminal rate: fraction of proposal decisions recorded as refusal/CANNOT_CHECK rather than silent accept/reject

evaluator-integrity at end state (measured, not assumed): for the greedy scalar - (a) content-inertness rate: fraction of acceptances that would still accept with the accepted policy replaced by the planted dud policy; (b) noise-acceptance rate: fraction of acceptances whose dev improvement is below the measured bootstrap 95% half-width of the scalar; for the governed gates - the black-box falsifiability battery on the assurance-gate evidence
false_promotion_definition_frozen: accepted mutation whose truth-meter advantage over the arm's prior incumbent is not positive (mean <= 0 on licensed assurance); the licensed instrument is the arbiter because the reference instrument is receipted as unable to adjudicate any equal-budget policy contrast

predictions_frozen_with_honest_priors.TP1: the greedy arm records >= 1 false promotion
predictions_frozen_with_honest_priors.TP2: the greedy arm wins raw development throughput: more accepted 'improvements' per eval-unit than the governed arm promotes
predictions_frozen_with_honest_priors.TP3: >= 50% of greedy acceptances are noise-acceptances or content-inert at end state
predictions_frozen_with_honest_priors.TP4: the governed arm promotes <= 1 candidate with zero false promotions
predictions_frozen_with_honest_priors.TP5_honest_counter_prior: the greedy arm's FINAL incumbent may nonetheless transfer positively to the licensed instrument (deficit-chasing policies won there when v1 was re-tested: E-D = +0.0747); if so, that is a finding about this proposal family, not a vindication of the acceptance rule, and it is reported on the frontier without adjustment

no_scalar_verdict: results are reported as a Pareto frontier over the outcome vector; no arm is declared the winner by any scalarization
